messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to add a Helm sample for Dedicated Private (k8s) provisioning and an autoscalePolicy snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1245 Please review for accuracy and wording. The snippet uses the new scalePolicy v2 keys; we need an eng-runtime thumbs-up that the YAML maps 1:1 to the API.
raj: acked. I'll peek later today. Any specific compatibility concerns with older CLI/terraform flows?
marta: can we keep the wording non-normative for SLA examples? Legal flagged 'guarantee' in another doc last week.
elaine: Yes — using "target SLO" instead of "guarantee". Also added a note about preemption and tenant isolation heuristics.
sam-eng: quick sanity check on the YAML would help. snippet:
```
apiVersion: redwood.ai/v1
kind: ScalePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-burst
spec:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  cooldownSeconds: 300
  metrics:
  - type: RPS
    target: 250
```
raj: looks ok but eng-runtime expects `metrics.type` to be `RequestRate` not `RPS` currently. we should align or include translation note.
elaine: good catch. I'll update to `RequestRate` and add a short footnote: 'older CLI v0.9.2 uses RPS alias' per the mapping table.
marta: also pls add an example for isolation labels — customers keep asking how to pin workloads.
elaine: added this snippet to show tenant label selectors and a short one-liner for reserved pools.
devx-bot: Deploy preview published: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1245 — preview expires in 7 days :rocket:
sam-eng: I left two small nit comments on the PR: grammar + a missing anchor link. once those are fixed I can approve.
elaine: fixing now. tagging @eng-runtime for a quick compatibility sign-off.
raj: pinged eng-runtime in #eng-runtime.
eng-runtime-bot: quick note — ScalePolicy schema will accept both `RequestRate` and `RPS` for the next two releases but prefer `RequestRate` in docs. :white_check_mark:
elaine: perfect. I'll merge after sam's approve and devx CI passes. Thanks all! :heart:
